Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A collaboration or recruitment inquiry submitted by an authenticated visitor.

authorUid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the sender.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

SavedResearch.title: SavedResearch
SavedResearch.description: A saved protein target or biomedical literature bookmark in the user's Science Workbench notebook.

ownerUid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the researcher who saved this item.

geneSymbol.description: Official gene symbol (e.g., INS, TP53, EGFR).

proteinName.description: Full protein title from UniProtKB/AlphaFold DB.

projectContext.description: Related portfolio project domain (e.g., Diabetes Prediction System or Brain Tumor MRI).

notes.description: User annotation or clinical hypothesis note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was updated.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Stores authenticated visitor inquiries with strict owner and admin read/write isolation.

/savedResearch/{recordId}.description: Stores personal bioinformatics and literature notes per authenticated user.
